# Steno

> Steno is a writing skill that teaches ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini to write like a person. Paste it into custom instructions once, or run it on text you already have. ₹4,999 / $56 one time. See real examples at https://steno-ai.vercel.app/#proof

## How it works

- Paste the instruction layer into custom instructions, project instructions or a system prompt. The model writes clean text from the start.
- Or run the skills file on text you already have. It keeps every fact and number and only changes how the text sounds.
- It targets twelve families of AI writing tells, such as puffed up openers, three item lists, vague attribution and uniform rhythm.

## Facts

- Price is ₹4,999 / $56, paid once. No subscription, no app, no login.
- Payment runs through Buy Me a Coffee. Card and UPI both work. The files unlock right after payment and a copy goes to your email.
- Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Cursor and any tool that takes custom instructions or a system prompt. Also works as a Claude skill.
- There are no refunds, because the files unlock as soon as you pay. Read the examples on the site first.
- Free updates are included, and you can use it for client work.
- Steno does not promise a score on any AI detector. Detectors change often, so the examples on the site link to QuillBot and GPTZero to check the results yourself.
